desc.T1: GRPO computes each rollout's advantage relative to the other rollouts in its group; with a single rollout per prompt the advantage is always zero and nothing is learned.
desc.T2: Assistant-only loss masking excludes tool outputs from the loss, so it cannot teach the model to reproduce them — the method contradicts the stated goal.
desc.T3: Dynamic batching raises throughput by waiting to group requests; for single requests it adds queueing delay and cannot lower latency.
desc.T4: Mixed precision keeps FP32 master weights and optimizer state, so switching to BF16 mixed precision saves far less than 4x memory.
